QuestInfo.name: Cracked Core
QuestInfo.0: Your core has been enhanced, but it's power is still unstable. Using it so much in your adventures must have damaged it. You better hope it doesn't break completely...
QuestInfo.1: #bAccording to the blacksmith, you need to brave the Blast Furnace to find Fire Ore for your core.#k Why can't things ever be easy? Better get going! \r\n#rTip: If you wish to go back to the Blast Furnace during the quest, you must forfeit the quest and start again.
QuestInfo.2: The core has been fully restored, and seems to be even more powerful than before! With this, you have completed your 3rd Job Advancement. Now find Burke and set the record straight!
